_about: The Week: bills on the live Adyta clock and Heat mail. Costs, Debt and the Heat ladder are from the First Edition rulebook (Cost of Living, Chapter Nine; Heat, Chapter Seven). Notice wording, fines and appeal numbers are drafts built on the World Anvil (Civic Institutions, Corporations) and marked status: draft.

housing.name: No fixed address (GM approval)
housing.note: Edge Dwellers and the like: off-registry, no rent, and anything needing a formal address is Hard.

week.debt: A character who doesn't cover weekly costs accumulates Debt: 1 Stress per session until cleared, and -1 Standing with anyone they owe.

heatBands.name: Scrutiny
heatBands.rule: The system can see you. Bureaucratic, not dramatic. +1 difficulty on Lay Low.

heatBands.name: Active attention
heatBands.rule: Someone is asking around. A named investigator, contractor, warden, or fixer starts digging.

heatBands.name: Crisis
heatBands.rule: Somebody has committed. It arrives before the next session ends unless actively disrupted. At 7 it is named and ongoing; at 8 it is citywide.

appeal.name: File with the APA
appeal.rule: Adyta Public Advocacy handles wrongful fines, evictions, utility disputes and compliance actions. Roll Savvy + Persuade; Wardens add +1 die because they know the paperwork. Challenging (2 successes) voids the notice. Otherwise it stands and you can still pay. One appeal per notice.

scrutiny.title: Compliance Flag: Address Review
scrutiny.body: Your registered address has been flagged for review following an irregularity in service records. A compliance fee resolves the flag. Crownline thanks you for helping keep Adyta safe, legal and connected.

scrutiny.title: Contact Card: Voluntary Interview
scrutiny.body: A warden left a card. They'd like a word about an incident in your district. Voluntary, for now.

check.label: Show up and talk
check.success: They have nothing that sticks. The card goes in a drawer.
check.fail: You said one thing too many. Your description is now in a report.

scrutiny.title: Record Discrepancy
scrutiny.body: Your civil record doesn't match a recent access log. Correcting it costs a filing fee. Uncorrected records get noticed.

scrutiny.title: Temporary Utility Limitation
scrutiny.body: Service to your address is under temporary limitation pending a safety review. Reconnection is available for a standard fee. This is not a shutoff. Crownline does not use that word.

attention.title: Request for Information
attention.body: Investigator {investigator} requests a conversation regarding an open matter. You are not under arrest. You are also not not under arrest.

check.label: Answer carefully
check.success: {investigator} leaves with less than they came for.
check.fail: {investigator} leaves with a name, a face and a timeline.

attention.title: Courtesy Visit Scheduled
attention.body: A Bastion contractor will conduct a courtesy visit to discuss recent activity near a client property. A service fee waives the visit.

attention.title: Lease Review
attention.body: Following reports about activity at your address, your lease is under review. Continued tenancy requires a one-time risk surcharge.

attention.title: Data Request
attention.body: Helix Systems has identified you as a person of research interest. A small privacy fee will remove your file from the active queue. Helix values your privacy.

crisis.title: Warrant Issued
crisis.body: An ACW warrant names you for questioning with temporary custody authorized. Wardens will look for you before the next session ends.

crisis.title: District Sweep
crisis.body: Bastion has a paid contract to sweep your district. They have a description. They have your route.

crisis.title: Notice of Responsible Transition
crisis.body: Your address is scheduled for responsible transition: an eviction with paperwork. Crews arrive before the next session ends.

crisis.title: Search Authorized
crisis.body: {investigator} has a search authorization for places you sleep, store things, or are known to visit.

crisis.title: Contract on Your Name
crisis.body: Someone put money on you. Not much. Enough.

escalation.rule: An ignored notice comes back at its deadline: Heat +1 and the fine x1.5 as a Second Notice. Ignore that and the Final Notice adds Heat +1 again and the fine becomes Debt.
